name: What is the typical timeframe for a custom kitchen renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a custom kitchen renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom kitchen renovation varies based on its complexity and scope. Smaller renovations might take 4-8 weeks, while extensive remodels involving structural changes, custom cabinetry, or reconfiguring plumbing and electrical can extend to 10-16 weeks or more. This timeline includes design, material selection, demolition, and installation. Unexpected issues, such as unforeseen structural elements or material delays, can sometimes impact the schedule. Our team provides a detailed project timeline upfront, keeping you informed at every stage of the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most custom kitchen renovations take 4-16 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope.
